_max_workers: 8 (owner by card 2026-11-02 18:35 PST, "How hard should Relentless run this machine?" -> "8 workers, 16 clones / 70 GB", from 4 workers and 10 clones / 40 GB; 8 workers + at most check_backlog_max checks + a consult fit the pool cap of 16 clones / 70 GB and the 24 GB seat slice, whose anon use was ~350 MB a scope, RELENTLESS_USAGE_MEASURE_NO_FLAT_GUESSES). The ceiling only, the total_max test ceiling of the plan. What runs is staffing's stage under the published budget. Steps back to 1 while available memory is under step_back_mem_gb (8); under min_mem_available_gb (6) nothing launches. relentless.worker_cap does the step-back.
_: The owner's tunable parameter and every limit of relentless.py, in data. See design/RimMandrake/relentless_owner_design_2026-10-31.md section 8 for why each number is what it is.
_only_system_and_live: Owner 2026-11-03: "Since we're near the end of our tokens, I'd like to pause all work EXCEPT system work and Live Testing." true: relentless.owner_hold, no new work on content; set false when he lifts it. It does not age out with the health verdict.
_pool_kinds_exclude: design/decision/decide/card are the Designer's (roles/designer.md, per mod, on demand) until the design is argued out: owner 2026-11-02 via the Coordinator, "all items once assigned to Bench and Foundry all become either Relentless or Designer, depending on what they currently need".
_pool_ids_exclude_steve_lane: STEVE_LANE_MONITOR_PAUSE_FINDINGS is a standing host, not work: testq ingest (LANE_ITEM) and findings_fold (lane_item) write onto it and its title says do not close while the lane runs, while `finish` closes. A pause is triaged by the steward ladder and Operations.
_pool_parked_lists: A list item the owner parked work on -> the ids it parks; the list item and every id are out of the line (relentless.parked_ids, asked by eligible, fill, retire and expedite). The paint list: his card 2026-10-09, WARSCAR_PILGRIM_CAMP_SITES_1 'done at the final world painting, not before'. Whoever adds an item to a paint list adds its id here; when the list item closes, delete its key. RELENTLESS_FILLER_FIX_TOO_KEEN_ON_PARKED: the filler staffed WARSCAR_PILGRIM_CAMP_SITES_1 off it.
_proof_paths: What a proof-only worker may land after a WEAK, as regexes on repo paths; a path the contract names counts too. Anything else is code and is refused without spending a Marker.
_one_builder_per_mod: Two workers on one game mod collide; several on different mods is the point. Mods come from the item, relentless.py item_mods.
_first_touch_hold: FIRST_TOUCH_BUILD_DESIGNER_READS_FIRST (owner 2026-11-03: "the first time an item names a mod, it gets a deep Designer pass ... then writes it all out for Relentless"): an unstarted item naming a mod with no Designer pass on record gets no worker; the pass item is filed once, needs=owner (first_touch.py, designer_passes.json). false switches the hold off.
_same_failure_limit: RELENTLESS_STRIKES_HARDEN_CHANGE_TACK (owner 2026-11-02, fix 4 of relentless_vs_foundry_2026-11-02.md): two returns of one class (blind_fail, proof_weak, a snag class) change the approach; after max_approach_changes changes the next trigger holds the item for the Conductor with a summary (relentless_strikes.py). item_spend_limit is the per-item token cap, held the same way.
_unmeasured: CHECKER_SANDBOX_FIX_BLIND_TO_STEVE (owner 2026-11-04: an inability to measure is reported up for fix and repair, never a FAIL): a Marker's UNMEASURED, or a FAIL whose reasons only say the box could not reach its evidence (relentless_wall.read_as), sends no work back and changes no approach. The candidate is checked again after unmeasured_recheck_s; unmeasured_limit in a row on one sha holds it (kind unmeasured, the seat's, Conductor attention) until the box or the contract's offbox reading is repaired. offbox_max_s bounds all of a check's off-box readings together (one deadline); offbox_adapters are the only things that run.

offbox_adapters._doc: Supervisor-owned off-box readings (GPT review of 0135b04912: no worker-authored command crosses the Marker's wall). A contract or unhold --offbox names one of these; the supervisor runs its argv with no shell, from an empty folder, with output capped at relentless_wall.OFFBOX_OUT_MAX bytes and all of a check's readings sharing offbox_max_s. `script` is the plain text of an -EncodedCommand, for review: they must match (selftest_relentless_blind).

steve_wsl_pydantic.what: SteveDesktop WSL testq worker deps, read now: one line pydantic=X pydantic_core=Y from ~/rm/pydeps (pip --target of src/RimMandrake/contracts/requirements.lock); an ImportError means not installed

steve_c_free.what: SteveDesktop C: free and size bytes, read now (Get-PSDrive C over ssh): one line '<UTC> free_bytes=N size_bytes=N'

_snag_again_wait_h: The same snag class again waits this many hours per earlier one, capped by MAX_WAIT_HOURS: nothing changes for a worker to find.
_blocker_classes: A worker's snag of one of these classes is a BLOCK, not a failed approach (relentless_block.py, PLAN_BUILD_BLOCKED_BY_IS_TEXT_ONLY): the ledger gets `rimflow block --kind <value>` and the item leaves the line until the block ends. Any other class starting blocked_ is an item wait too; --on or --blocker on the snag beats this table.
_account_settle_s: A run dead with no receipt and no sign of the account waits this long before it counts (a worker_lost strike, a checker toward checker_lost): `claude-account use` logs its event only after the fleet is back up (stop 21 s, verify 90 s; RELENTLESS_STRIKES_FIX_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_BLAMED).
_spend_limits: ADVISORY (owner 2026-11-02, TOKEN_LIMITS_TAME_BARK_NO_BITE: "Please make token limits advisory at this time everywhere. Nothing gets killed or stopped for that, but it might call attention from another agent (Conductor, Operations) to investigate and THAT agent may determine it needs to be killed for evidence-based reasons."). item_spend_limit and day_spend_limit are thresholds: crossing one journals an attention act and writes one line to the Conductor log and the told ledger (relentless.attention, each kind once per 6 h). Nothing is held, refused or stopped by them; run_reserve is the per-run estimate they add.
_warm_clones: Released clones kept warm (reset to origin/main) for the next item instead of deleted and re-cloned at 3.6 GB each; counted in the pool cap (relentless_disk.py, DISK_CHURN_MEASURE_CLONES_EAT_THE_VHDX).
_breaker: DI2 in operating_requirements_2026-11-01.md. A cool is capped at breaker_cool_max_s: 14400 slept 6 h on the 2026-11-01 jam. breaker_same_cause_opens opens by one cause inside breaker_same_cause_window_s (6 h, that jam's length) are an emergency: a told.jsonl row for breaker_reader, ack due in breaker_ack_min (OP3's default), plus the conductor log and staffing.alarm_item. A failure holding one of breaker_refusal_words is a wait, never a charge: the pool's refusal and memory after a clone.
_tick_game_budget_s: Game steps stop for this tick after this long: its gap plan can take live.gate_plan_max_s (180) more, and ops_watch's relentless.tick_age_s alarms at 10 min from one staffing.json write to the next, the timer's 2 min pause included. The unit kills at 1200 s, which loses lease and flush.
_live: relentless_live.py, the live tier (owner by card 2026-11-02: Relentless learns live testing). One built item's live criterion, a read-only proof on the running deployed game under the bridge lock. flyer_re refuses any run naming flight (standing ruling). forbid_re refuses a proof that would load, restart, swap or mutate the game. Seconds: proof_max_s for the proof, plan_max_s for deploy_custom_mods.py's plan. RA_S09: auto lets the tick start relentless_live_round.py (at most one, every round_every_s); a round runs up to round_max criteria that carry a `live-proof <CID>: <cmd>` line in their item's prose, and retries an UNMEASURED one after unmeasured_retry_s.
_game: RELENTLESS_LIVE_BUILD_ONE_AGENT_TWO_MODES (relentless_game.py): items whose needs is one of pool_needs join the pool; offline phase first, then the supervisor leases the bridge for ONE item at a time: implemented, blind rerun of its live-proof lines, staging (deploy + restart) only when the build is not running. stage_tries stagings, then the item is held.
_staffing: The no-AI filler, design section 13. Rises 3, 5, budget, each step only after a clean reading: hold_s at full stage, min_verdicts blind verdicts in that stage's window, at most max_reject_share rejected, memory never under step_back_mem_gb, no OOM kill, burn at most burn_max_pct_h. foreign_* are what a worker may take from the other seat without pulling its tree.
_circling: RW2, circling.py. Thresholds unmeasured: replay real runs before trusting one. stop stays false until circling_replay.json, written by `circling.py replay --write` from hand-labelled runs on this code and these numbers, shows wrongful stops under false_stop_limit; the flag alone stops nothing.
_help: RW3 in operating_requirements_2026-11-01.md. help_after_circling stops of class circling force one consult; one per item per help_cool_h, a worker's own call included. help_launch_tries runs a consult may die with no answer before the item carries on without it, help_max_s one run's limit, help_wait_s how long a wanted consult may wait for room while it holds the next worker back. help_vendor_from_round: from that consult on an item (round, not launch try) the consult is a second vendor through gpt_consult (design relentless_agent section 7); unset, every round is help_agent.

staffing._widen: Owner card 2026-11-02 18:35 PST: 8 workers, 16 clones / 70 GB. stages 4 -> 8, launch_per_tick 2 -> 3, work_launch_per_tick 2 -> 4, check_backlog_max 2 -> 4 so 8 places fill in a few ticks.
staffing._work_launch_per_tick: builders' clones a tick, apart from launch_per_tick (checks and consults): one shared count let two checks stop every builder, so runs shorter than a tick left 1 of 4 places working (RELENTLESS_SLOTS_UNSTICK_BLOCKED_PUT_DOWN, 2026-11-02)

_walls: What a mode may not see (relentless_wall.py). enforce false changes no launch; `relentless wall` reports what it would deny.
